summary: The MaintITProvisionRole file pertains to the maintenance and management of IT Provisioning roles within the HSPnet application.
purpose: To facilitate the management, addition, update, deactivation, and reactivation of IT Provisioning roles within an organization through a web-based interface.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Primary identifier for IT Provision Role entries.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the IT Provision Role.

fields.name: ShortName
fields.description: A shorter version or abbreviation of the IT Provision Role name.

actors.name: UserSession
actors.role: Represents the current user session and contains permissions and settings.

actors.name: LocalAdministrator
actors.role: User with administrative control at a local level.

workflows.name: IT Provision Role Management
steps: Allow addition, update, and deletion of roles based on access.

business_rules: Only users with SystemAdministrator or LocalAdministrator rights can modify IT Provision Roles.
ITProvisionRoleID determines if a role is being added or updated.
Agencies must be populated and selectable; if empty, editing is disabled.
conditions: Screen is editable if the user is a SystemAdministrator or LocalAdministrator and current agency is not empty.
Edit buttons are enabled based on role activeness and user permissions.
system_behavior: IT Provision Roles can be created, updated, deleted, and reactivated through UI commands.
User interface dynamically changes to reflect user permissions and actions.
exceptions: If no agency is selected, editing functionalities are disabled.
Roles cannot be deleted if access is restricted.
content_gaps: Detailed error handling mechanisms are not fully described.
